name: loading-carousel
title: Loading Carousel
blurb: Auto-rotating carousel of image tiles with progress indicators and optional…
description: Displays a carousel of tips with images, text, and progress bars. Uses embla-carousel for smooth looping and respects prefers-reduced-motion. Configurable autoplay, text position, navigation buttons, and progress bars.
use_when: Highlighting multiple related items, tips, or features with images in a guided, self-advancing carousel.
avoid_when: Fixed autoplay without user control can overwhelm screen reader users; provide showNavigation for accessibility.
a11y: Keyboard and click navigation via indicator buttons. Respects prefers-reduced-motion. ARIA labels on buttons and indicators. Focus-visible rings.
